storyBody: Sign in with your mobile number to see your care journey, orders, and appointments.
privacy: Access uses a one-time code only. We will never ask you for a permanent password.
loginIntro: Enter the mobile number you use for Fazaieli services.
phoneError: Enter a valid Iranian mobile number.
verifyIntro: Enter the six-digit code sent to your mobile number.
codeHint: Type or paste the six-digit code from the message.
codeError: The code must contain exactly six digits.
genericError: We could not complete this request. Please try again shortly.
invalidCode: That code is invalid or has expired. Please try again.
missingPhone: Enter your mobile number before continuing.
